thread:
Maria Chen: Customer reported they close the SSE early and we still bill full tokens. Looks like partial-stream accounting is broken. anyone seen this? :confused:
Ashok Patel: Seen it. Fastly + our LB can swallow client 499 -> backend shows 200 finish. billing loses disconnect marker.
Ciara O'Donnell: I traced a case: proxy sends RST_STREAM, kernel still had queued bytes, runtime keeps generating until write fails.
Tom Nguyen: Our Go runtime is supposed to short-circuit on client disconnect (SIGPIPE). Is that not firing?
Ashok Patel: Usually yes, but with chunked SSE and some proxy configs, the TCP close is deferred. writes succeed locally, so generator keeps going for hundreds of tokens.
Luis Alvarez: For billing we currently count "tokens generated by runtime". That overcharges when client drops early. Need to choose: bill on generation or bill on confirmed delivery.
Ciara O'Donnell: Billing-on-delivery is tricky with retransmits and flaky proxies. Idea: emit an explicit final SSE event (`event: finished`) so clients can detect normal completion.
Maria Chen: Good idea but doesn't guarantee client actually received it. Mobile clients may never implement ack.
Tom Nguyen: We can add an ack endpoint: client POST /v1/streams/<req-id>/ack after seeing the finish event. SDKs can auto-ack.
Luis Alvarez: If we have an ack, billing can bill full amount when ack received within 60s, otherwise apply a disputed/discount rule. Enterprise customers could opt for delivery billing.
Ciara O'Donnell: Rollout caveat: many existing clients won't ack. Need a fallback path and grace period.
Ashok Patel: Implementation notes: `finish` event looks like:

```
event: finish
id: <req-id>
data: {"status":"complete","token_count":324}

```

Tom Nguyen: Ack endpoint needs idempotency and auth check (session token). We must prevent ack spoofing.
Maria Chen: Console changes: add column `stream:ack_status` to route table and an aggregate metric `partial_stream_rate` + overlay on token spend graph.
Luis Alvarez: Also add a temporary disputed-tokens metric per-customer so billing can reconcile invoices.
Ciara O'Donnell: Telemetry: add `x-stream-terminated-reason` enum with values `client_close`, `proxy_reset`, `backend_error`, `finish_sent`, `ack_received`. Sample 1% of streams with full edge+backend traces.
Ashok Patel: Fastly config may be dropping trailing flush/chunk. I'll repro with a local proxy and tcpdump. Opening INFRA-1298 to track.
infra-bot: Created task INFRA-1298 to test Fastly/TCP flush behavior.
billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-842 to draft billing modes (generation vs delivery) assigned to Luis.
Tom Nguyen: Rollout proposal: enable finish event canary at 10% traffic for 2 weeks, measure ack_rate and token deltas, then release SDK update to auto-ack.
Ciara O'Donnell: For sampling, include sampled req-ids in console trace view with link to tcpdump/edge logs.
Ashok Patel: Repro plan: curl SSE, close client early, simulate proxy linger, compare backend emitted tokens vs delivered chunks. I'll paste logs here.
Luis Alvarez: I'll draft the billing policy with examples (invoice scenarios) and share by EOD Friday.
Tom Nguyen: I'll start ack endpoint PR tomorrow, WIP. Will include auth guard and 2-minute expiry window for ack acceptance.
Maria Chen: Action owners: Ashok (repro + Fastly ticket), Tom (ack endpoint PR), Ciara (telemetry + sampling), Luis (billing doc). Security signed off on ack approach earlier.
Ciara O'Donnell: :+1: Security signoff noted. No blockers.
Maria Chen: OK. If no objections, we proceed. We'll reconvene after canary metrics are in. :rocket:
